action.approach: Original room hotspot route occurs before activity. Within the existing close-up work canvas, complete figure translates on a bounded line with fixed current whole-figure size; facing chooses an unclipped figure. No new source art, camera, costume or scene.
action.commit: World validates live request, phase, target, work interval, actual AtlasTexture region, unaltered uniform actor size and <=4 viewport-pixel candidate jaw gap before original surface drop/flow/checkpoint. No timer callback independently grants progress.
action.cancel: Focus, actual tree pause, configure/phase change and close restore pending tile through existing source/tray conservation; cancel presentation and enter safe pose. Committed tile is preserved.
action.save: Pending target is omitted, source state conserved. Original released-grid/flow schema, signature and version1 remain.
